title: test(objectql): pin the environment overlay of a packaged item for the five overlay-enabled types
body:
Part of #22340
Clause-②: no

This is stage S1 of #22340, claimed in the amendment comment 6069745527. It pins the environment overlay of the five overlay-enabled metadata types under the flag's current name, `allowOrgOverride`, and changes tests only. The rename is stage S2 and is not in this PR. #22340 stays open.

## What this adds

This PR adds one new test file, `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`. It runs on the real `ObjectQL` engine and `SchemaRegistry` and the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, on both topologies: an environment kernel (`environmentId` set) and a host-config kernel (none). The harness follows `engine-security-catalog-package-door.test.ts`. No source file changes.

Each of `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation` and `email_template` gets three checks, and the first two run on both topologies:

1. **Write.** `saveMetaItem` over the packaged item is accepted (`success: true`) and stores exactly one `sys_metadata` row. That row names no organization (`organization_id` is NULL), and the item's read then serves the body that was written.
2. **Read of a stored overlay.** An environment-wide row goes straight into the store, with no write door in front of it, and `getMetaItem` serves it. As a control, the same read serves the package's item before the row exists.
3. **Wire.** `getMetaTypes` advertises `allowOrgOverride: true` with `overrideSource: 'registry'` for the type. The `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` hatch is cleared for every case, so it cannot stand in for the registry.

One more case pins the identity: the registry types whose flag is `true` are exactly these five. The file writes the five out instead of reading them from the registry, so a type that leaves the flag fails its own cases by name.

No `organizationId` reaches any call, and the protocol has no organization of its own. When #15206 S3 to S5 delete the per-organization path, these cases still stand.

There are 26 cases: 1 identity case, 20 write and read cases (5 types, 2 topologies, 2 legs) and 5 wire cases.

## Measured on `origin/main` (`1cb0edb82`) before writing

- All five environment-wide overlays are accepted on both topologies today. No stop condition fired: none of the five is refused, and none needs an `organizationId`.
- Four of the packaged items come in through the manifest's own stack collections (`views`, `dashboards`, `reports`, `emailTemplates`), the seam that stamps package provenance. `translation` has no such collection (see Acceptance notes). Its packaged item is registered through the registry's package seam, `registerItem(type, item, 'name', packageId)`, which is the entry `isArtifactBacked` reads.
- The single-item read, `getMetaItem`, serves a stored active row without consulting the flag or `supportsOverlay` (see Acceptance notes).

## Pins that already exist, not repeated here

| type | already pinned elsewhere | added here |
|---|---|---|
| view | dispatcher PUT (`runtime/src/meta-field-overlay-lock.test.ts`); package-door verdict (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`); repository write (`metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.package-writability.test.ts`); wire flag on a mock engine (`objectql/src/protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`) | the stored row's organization, the served body, the wire flag on the real engine |
| dashboard | dispatcher PUT (`runtime/src/meta-field-overlay-lock.test.ts`) | all three checks on the protocol |
| report | none | all three checks |
| translation | none | all three checks |
| email_template | the save over a packaged template on both topologies (the control in `objectql/src/engine-security-catalog-package-door.test.ts`) | the stored row's organization, the served body, the wire flag |

Each existing pin reads one layer of one type, and none of them reads the stored row's organization, the served body and the wire flag together. The `email_template` save is the one overlap. Here it is only the first step of a round trip that goes on to read those three things.

**No dispatcher case in `packages/runtime`.** For an environment-wide write (a `manage_metadata` session with no active organization), the dispatcher reads the flag nowhere:

- `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict` admits `manage_metadata` before it reads the flag.
- `organizationIdForMetaWrite` returns `undefined` before it reads the flag.

Both read the flag only for a session with an active organization, which is the per-organization path. The dispatcher hands this same request to `saveMetaItem`, and the existing view and dashboard dispatcher pins already cover that transport.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

- **Mutation.** `report`'s flag was flipped to `false` in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Its evidence: anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `47f68e76cb5c` → `01bfde907a81`.
- **Rebuild.** `@objectstack/spec` was rebuilt, because the test and `metadata-protocol`'s dist both import the registry from spec's `dist/`. `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in 4 built files: `dist/kernel/index.js`, `dist/kernel/index.mjs`, `dist/browser/kernel/index.js` and `dist/browser/kernel/index.mjs`.
- **Prediction, written before the run.** 4 red and 22 green. The red cases would be the identity, `report`'s write on both topologies and `report`'s wire flag. `report`'s two read cases would stay green, because the read consults no flag.
- **Result.** **4 failed | 22 passed (26)**, and the four were exactly the predicted ones:
  - identity: received `["dashboard","email_template","translation","view"]`;
  - write, on both topologies: received `{ refused: { code: 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE', status: 403 } }`;
  - wire: received `allowOrgOverride: false`, `overrideSource: 'registry'`.
- **Restore.** The tool restored the file with `git checkout HEAD --`: the blob equals HEAD's (`47f68e76cb5c`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Spec was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` passed: the marker is absent from all 232 built files and the whole tree is clean. The re-run passed **26 of 26**.

## Verification (head `db89d66f0`)

- **New file.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`: 26 passed.
- **Package suite.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 388 files and 7633 tests passed.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql run typecheck` (tsc plus the test-layer program) is OK. The new file has no ledger entry in `test-typecheck-debt.json`, so it compiles with zero errors.
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` was re-derived from the branch's change set and gave the same 56 commands as the dispatch. 55 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every workspace package built. It is NOT MEASURED here, and CI builds the workspace. The `--ran` verdict reads: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 56 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- **Lint, narrowed to the one file.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 1 file with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The file is in eslint's own population: `--print-config` returns a config with 5 rules for it. Type-aware linting is not enabled (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so adding this file cannot change another file's result.
- **Runtime or integration tiers.** Not touched.

## Changeset

There is no changeset, because this diff publishes nothing:

- objectql's `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/*.test.ts` from the build.
- After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql run build`, the file's fixture strings appear 0 times in every path of `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). As a positive control, `registerMetadataCollections` appears in 6 files under `dist`.

The repo's opt-out for a diff that publishes nothing is the `skip-changeset` label, and it is applied.

## Acceptance notes

- **No in-repo producer puts a packaged `translation` into the `SchemaRegistry`.** This is a reading of four seams at `1cb0edb82`, not a boot measurement:
  - `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` (`objectql/src/engine.ts`) has no `translations` collection.
  - The artifact door's `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` (`metadata/src/plugin.ts`) has none either.
  - The filesystem scanner (`MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem` with its `packageId` option) stamps `_packageId`, but it registers into `MetadataManager`'s own map.
  - `ObjectQLPlugin.loadMetadataFromService` copies only `object`, `view`, `app`, `flow` and `hook` into the `SchemaRegistry`.

  So in today's composition, `isArtifactBacked` is false for every `translation`. An environment-wide translation write is then admitted by `allowRuntimeCreate`, not by the flag. The `translation` cases here pin the protocol's verdict for a packaged translation if one is ever registered. Today the flag's live effect on `translation` is the per-organization path and the Studio wire gate. This is noted for #22340's S2 contract review and not filed.
- **The single-item read keys on neither the flag nor `supportsOverlay`.** `getMetaItem` serves a stored active row unless `declinesStoredRow` holds, which covers shipped flows and code-defined datasources only. `supportsOverlay` has one protocol reader, `mergesOverlayAtRead`, and only the delete door (`refusePackagedBaseRemoval`) calls it. So stage 0's reading, "the read keys on `supportsOverlay`", does not hold for this read. What holds, and what the ablation shows, is that the read consults no flag. This is noted for #22340 S2 and not filed.
- **Cross-lane.** The file sits in a `domain:engine` package. The lane was told in the cross-lane declaration on #6367 (comment 6069783273).
